newsitem.title: UK: NWE spot naphtha slightly weaker, buyers relaxed.
newsitem.headline: NWE spot naphtha slightly weaker, buyers relaxed.

text.p: NWE spot naphtha markets were slightly weaker again on Thursday with volatile crude, with the emphasis to the downside, keeping buyers scarce, traders said.
Some enquiry was heard from petrochemical end-users seeking an alternative to high priced LPG feedstock, but traders expected business to stay thin amid an air of bearish sentiment.
An Algerian cargo for mid-September loading was offered to the market at around $204-$205 a tonne cif NWE.
Buying interest prevailed for N+A barrels from refiners seeking platformer feedstock, but tight supplies of the heavy naphtha kept trade thin. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7456
